quiz_title: Class 57: Vachanamrut and Swamini Vato Overview

questions.question_text: Vachanamrut Gadhada Pratham 37 pramāṇe, "Amārī sevā kartā hoy ne tenā hṛudaymā jo parameshwarnī bhakti na hoy to te upar ______ karīe toy paṇ na thāy."
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states: "Amārī sevā kartā hoy ne tenā hṛudaymā jo parameshwarnī bhakti na hoy to te upar het karīe toy paṇ na thāy."

questions.question_text: Swamini Vato 5/311 pramāṇe, "Satsangmā kusangno jog thāy ne brahmarūp hoy to shū karī nākhe?"
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato states: "Satsangmā kusangno jog thāy ne brahmarūp hoy to dehrūp karī nākhe".

questions.question_text: Swamini Vato 5/311 pramāṇe, "Satsangmā sārāno jog thāy to dehrūp hoy tene shū kare?"
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato states: "ne satsangmā sārāno jog thāy to dehrūp hoy tene brahmarūp kare."

questions.question_text: Vachanamrut Gadhada Antya 12 pramāṇe, "Jene Bhagwān tathā bhagwānnā bhakta teno avaguṇ āvyo hoy ne te satsangī kahevāto hoy to paṇ tene koṇ jevo jāṇvo?"
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states: "Bhagwān tathā bhagwānnā bhakta teno jene avaguṇ āvyo hoy ne te satsangī kahevāto hoy to paṇ tene haḍkāyā shvān jevo jāṇvo."

questions.question_text: Vachanamrut Gadhada Antya 12 pramāṇe, "Jem haḍkāyā shvānnī lāḷ jene aḍe tene paṇ haḍkavā hāle; tem jene bhagwān ne bhagwānnā bhaktano avaguṇ āvyo hoy te sāthe je het rākhe athavā tenī vāt sāmbhaḷe, to te hetno karnāro ne vātno sāmbhaḷnāro paṇ __________ thāy."
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states: "to te hetno karnāro ne vātno sāmbhaḷnāro paṇ vimukh sarkho thāy."

questions.question_text: Vachanamrut Loyano 1 pramāṇe, "Jene potāne nishchay karāvyo hoy ne te ja vaḷī em kahe je e Bhagwān nathī tyāre ene em jāṇe je ‘enu māthu faryu chhe.’ Evo je hoy tene __________ kahīe."
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states: "Evo je hoy tene uttam gnānvāḷo kahīe."

questions.question_text: Narsinh Mehtā rachit Kirtan pramāṇe, "Mārā harjī shu het na dīse re tene gher shīd jaīe?" Koṇ sāthe sang na karvo joīe?
options: Jene Harjī shu het na dīse
Jene Harjī nu nām na game
Jene Harjī nu darshan na thāy
Jene Harjī no mahimā na samajāy
questions.correct_answer: Jene Harjī shu het na dīse
questions.explanation: The Kirtan begins with: "Mārā harjī shu het na dīse re tene gher shīd jaīe, Tene sange shīd rahīe re...".

questions.question_text: Narsinh Mehtā rachit Kirtan pramāṇe, "bhaktibhāvno bhed na jāṇe ne, bhurāyo thaīne bhāḷe re" - āvī vyakti sāthe shū karvu joīe?
questions.explanation: The Kirtan's refrain is "Tene sange shīd rahīe re...". The second verse describes such a person.

questions.question_text: Narsinh Mehtā rachit Kirtan pramāṇe, "Jānvī tīre tarang tajīne, pachhī taṭmā jaīne kūp khode re" - te koṇā viṣhe kahyu chhe?
options: Jene nām taṇo vishvās na āve ne ūndu te ūndu shodhe
Jene Harjī shu het na dīse
questions.correct_answer: Jene nām taṇo vishvās na āve ne ūndu te ūndu shodhe
questions.explanation: The Kirtan links this action directly with "Nām taṇo vishvās na āve, ne ūndu te ūndu shodhe re".

questions.question_text: Narsinh Mehtā rachit Kirtan pramāṇe, "Narasaiyānā swāmīnī līlā, olyā matiyā kahe chhe shū?"
questions.explanation: The Kirtan states: "Narasaiyānā swāmīnī līlā, olyā matiyā kahe chhe māyā re".
